create_model: create a CLIP model from a config name with optional pretrained weights and precision settings
create_model_and_transforms: create a CLIP model along with train and validation image preprocessing transforms
get_tokenizer: get a tokenizer function either the default CLIP tokenizer or a HuggingFace AutoTokenizer
list_models: list all available model architecture names registered from JSON config files
add_model_config: add a new model config directory or file path to the model registry
